units.rule: A line seals the node key to exactly one recipient
scenarios: Owner and grantee each open their line
A line is bound to its node and version
A header without an owner line is invalid

units.rule: Grant is one appended line, touching nobody
scenarios: Granting a new reader leaves every other line untouched

units.rule: Rotation cuts the revoked and re-links the parent
scenarios: The revoked gets no line in the new version
An up-link wrap restores derivation for the parent holder
